_comment: GENERATED from deploy/helm/cogneva/files/cogneva.json by deploy/scripts/gen-example-config.py -- do not edit this file; edit the chart and re-run the script. The alert rule list keeps ten example rules and github_integration.repo is a placeholder; every other key is the shipped configuration. Place this file at /etc/cogneva/cogneva.json or set COGNEVA_CONFIG_PATH env.

bounds._comment: 系统给自己设的界的登记处。默认立场：一个进程还在干活，就不该被一个我们事先挑好的数杀掉或判死——已按这个立场拆了一批（推送墙、构建预算、测试预算、验证门禁、kubectl 读写、git 命令、flat retry 预算、supervisor 各趟 pass、checkpoint 各步、整轮流式生成的总时长、网关工作区的 git 动作、网关镜像传输的按钟总时长、备份与变更执行 Job 的 activeDeadlineSeconds——改成进程往 COGNEVA_PROGRESS_FILE 写窗口、kubelet 读文件年龄），做法是「等它自己结束，过了声明的钟点只登一行读数」，那条控制律只有一份：crates/cog-core/src/declared_wall.rs。这里登记**没有拆**的界，只有一只篮子 kept：判定为不该拆，每条写清楚为什么不拆。曾经还有一只 scheduled（同一个形状、只是没轮到的界），随最后一个按钟杀 Job 的期限一起删掉了——留着它只会变成「登记了就等于交代过了」。门：crates/cogneva/tests/bounds_registry_test.rs 逐条核对 file 存在、symbol 真在那个文件里、两只篮子字段齐不齐；从代码里删掉一条界而没删这里的登记，那条门就红。

kept.why: 同上，平台级评测的整场时限。它定义的是这一场评测有多长，不是对一件仍在推进的工作的限制。
安全控制，不是工期界。放开它等于把暴力破解的代价降到零；它结束的是猜口令的请求本身，不是任何正在产出的工作。
一次只读采样超时，丢掉的是这一次读数，没有任何正在产出的东西被杀；被问的那一端本来也没有为我们攒着什么成果，下一次采样照常，面板上最多空一格。
判的是「还在排队的那个人还在不在」：超过这么久没续位，按已放弃处理，把槽位让给下一个。它不杀任何正在跑的构建，清掉的是一行没人再续的登记。
停机宽限。到点进程必须退出，否则整个 Pod 被 SIGKILL、连接不排空、WAL 不写完——那比杀掉一个收尾钩子更伤。唯一一类「必须有个终点」的等待。

它判的不是这一轮生成有多长，是两次事件之间隔了多久：上游一直在吐 token 就一直等，60 秒一个事件都没有才判这条流停住了。按总时长的那条墙（STREAM_TOTAL_TIMEOUT／chat_timeout／CHAT_CONSUME_TIMEOUT）已经拆掉——上游还在出东西的时候把它切断，作废的是已经推进的那一段。首事件之前放宽到 STREAM_FIRST_EVENT_GAP，因为长推理窗口本来就会安静很久。

它是提交方写进任务契约的声明，不是平台手里的刀：crates/cog-core/src/contract/work_item.rs 写明平台不按任何已用时长掐一件正在跑的活，所以这个数只说明这张问票预期多久，删掉它只是抹掉一条可读的意图。真正决定放不放弃的是这一侧自己的耐心 ASSESS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS——那也不是判决，交活的一方停止等待时活还在跑，结果照样落到行上。两者都不是「到点杀掉正在干活的进程」，不该按 declared_wall 改。
同上一条：写进任务契约的是提交方的预期，平台不按它掐活；交叉验证跑得久只说明它还在跑，放弃等待的是调用方那一侧，而不是把正在复核的东西扔掉。
写进任务契约的是提交方对一次抽取的预期，平台不按它掐正在跑的抽取。真正会让人以为「失败了」的是等待那一侧的 EXTRACT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS，而它按契约只是这一侧的耐心：停止等待时活还在跑，答案照样落到行上，所以它也没有杀任何东西，两条都不该按 declared_wall 改。
同记忆抽取那一条：任务行的 EXTRACT 式声明只表达预期，平台不按已用时长收任何正在跑的活；配套的 DISTILL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS 是调用方的耐心，放弃等待不等于蒸馏被掐断，两者都不在杀正在产出的工作。
它现在只决定「比预期慢了要说一声」，不决定收不收：过了这个点登一行告警，然后继续等这次传输自己结束。唯一还会杀进程的是 stall 判据——传输静默了（没有任何进度输出），那判的不是「慢」而是「已经死了」，而且杀的是整个进程组，不是只收走那个壳。按总时长的钟已经拆掉：一次还在传的 fetch/push 被杀掉，作废的是已经传过去的那一段，下一次还得从头再传。

它管的是「这一次尝试已经结束了，要不要再来一次」，不是「一件还在跑的活要不要收走」——所以属主要的「只要没死还在工作就要等」不适用，无上限重试只会把所有确定性失败变成永远转下去的活。真正在跑的那些等待已经不归它管：确定性失败预算直接归零，环境拒绝（池停供、进程被要求停）记在环境头上而不是任务头上。另外它和 Task::max_retries 不是两份各自为政的数：调度器判决读的是这一份，任务上存的那一份在判决点会被写成生效的这一份，所以落库的行里 retry_count 与 max_retries 的比较就是当时真做的那个判决。
同上一条：账的是已经结束的那次尝试。这个字段在调度器里不是判决输入（判决读 RetryMatrix），它是一份要跟生效值一致的落库副本——台账表的默认值是 0，所以不能简单地拿它去压矩阵的上限，否则一条从没声明过的老行会被读成「一次都不许重试」。消耗完时会落成终态 Failed 并进死信，失败原因看得见，不会被重试盖住。
它判的是**看不见的那一侧**此刻通不通（选路探测），不是一件我们看得见产出的活要不要继续——这是以秒为判据的界唯一允许的用法。过点即判该通道此刻不可用并记下读数；正常请求的等待由业务侧自己的界管，不归这条。若不判，一条挂死的通道会把选路整个拖住，而选路的全部意义就是避开它。
同上：探针问的是「这个对端现在通不通」，5 秒答不上来本身就说明它此刻对我们是不可用的。它不杀任何我们自己的活，只决定这一次探测记什么读数；探测的目标清单与引导脚本同一份。
SSH 自证探针：一条 `git ls-remote` 走完 DNS、TCP、SSH 与鉴权。判的是这条通道此刻通不通，过点即判未通过，进程组连同已做的工作一起收走——收走的是探针，不是用户的工作。不能拿它去判「一件正在跑的活该不该继续」，那两件事的形状不同。
向平台密钥服务要一次部署密钥的 HTTP 往返：对端是不可观测的外部服务，等不到就是等不到，这条界决定这一次请求报什么，不决定我们自己的哪件活该被收走。
首事件之前量的是**没有进展**，不是这一轮跑了多久：长推理窗口的上游在吐出第一个字之前可以安静很久，那是它还在想。安静到十分钟一个事件都没有，才按这条流不可用收尾。同族的 STREAM_EVENT_TIMEOUT 管首事件之后，两个数分工是「想想可以，卡住不行」，都不按总时长判。
声明不是判据：这个数写在任务行上，说明提交者预期这件活跑多久；回收判据（`reclaim_cause`）只认租约与实测的步间隔，按它判死的那条路已经拆掉。`timeout_seconds` 现在只喂两处读数——发现册子的 outcome_deadline「按经验该有结局了」与 UI 的预期」，都不杀任何进程。
声明不是判据：agent 提交一件活时没写预算才用这个数，它只落在任务行上喂 `outcome_deadline` 那种「按经验该有结局了」的读数；执行侧不按它收任何还在跑的活（回收只看租约与实测步间隔）。
声明不是判据，而且是**提问方自己**的耐心：一次「问另一个 agent」最多让提问方这一回合等多久，超了只把结果记成 timeout 并回给模型——被问的那条运行不受影响，它照常跑。等不去杀别人，也不被别人的钟杀。
量的是**没有进展**：每来一个流事件它就被重置，只有 240 秒一个事件都没有才判停，同一族是 llm-first-event-gap。它结束的是一个已经不动的连接，不是一个还在产出的回合——一次长思考只要模型还在吐事件就不受影响。
它**不杀任何东西**：容器的死活由备份 Job 的存活探针按进度文件判（一步都不推进超过窗口才判死）。这个数只写进账本 backup_runs 那一行，让「这一行开着但没人收尾」有一个可判的时刻——一份开着的记录如果有人被杀，只有它自己被开出来时的那个数判得了。
量的是**当前这一步静默了多久**，不是这一趟花了多久：解包、核清单、建空库、恢复、对数，任何一步静默超界才收尾，判词点名停在哪一步。整趟不受它约束——两步各跑一小时也照样跑完。它替换掉的是整趟预算，2026-10-27 那次正是被整趟预算杀掉的。

它不杀任何东西：Deployment 控制器到点只把 `Progressing` 置成 `False`（reason `ProgressDeadlineExceeded`）并写进对象状态，Pod 照跑、滚动继续；本仓库里没有任何代码或清单拿这条状态做决定（读它的只有网关那张工作负载读数），所以它结束不了任何正在推进的工作。这个字段也无法「去掉」——不写时生效的是同一个 600 秒的 API 默认值；写出来只是让它不再是清单上看不见的数。

system._comment_loop_restart: 后台循环 panic 后原地重跑的次数上限（连续计），以及事件驱动循环的重启等待下限（秒）。有节奏的循环按自己声明的周期等，等待逐次翻倍、上限是该周期的 6 倍——这个倍数与停滞规则用的同一个。0 表示不重启：panic 与没有这个机制时一样致命。超预算的循环留死不再重启（进程不因此退出，退出会变成崩溃循环并把同进程其它循环一起拖垮），由 cogneva_loop_deaths_total 与停滞规则上报；每次重跑记在 cogneva_loop_restarts_total 上，规则 background_loop_restarted 会告警，所以「重启过了」不等于「没事了」。这两项是进程属性而不是某个循环的属性，启动时安装一次、对所有循环生效。有节奏的循环，deaths 与停滞规则一起回答「它还在不在」；事件驱动的循环（周期为 0）被停滞规则按定义排除，它们「退出过没有」只能由 deaths 配上 cogneva_loop_registered 读：registered=1 且 deaths=0 说的是「这一进程起过它、它没退出过」，答不了「此刻卡在 body 里」——那一态与空转同形，今天没有读数。停机信号触发时的正常退出不计入 deaths。
system._comment_plugin_filtering: Plugin loading control. enabled_plugins = whitelist (omit for all). disabled_plugins = blacklist (applied when enabled_plugins is omitted).

env._comment: Environment-variable → config-path mappings. Keys are env-var names, values are dot-separated JSON paths inside this file.

llm_routing._comment: 多 LLM 故障转移。api_style 声明兼容的 API 风格：openai 或 anthropic。默认 openai。

backends._comment: 主应用与沙盒一致零凭证零上游知识：api_key 是写死的非敏感占位串（后端构建要求非空），流量经安全网关 8081 透传，真 key 只在网关 Pod。api_style 钉 openai 匹配透传面；model 同样是占位，网关透传时改写为向导配置的真实模型。多 LLM 故障转移（429/402 切上游）由安全网关的上游池承担。LLM 平等：业务侧配置不出现任何厂商名。

同一条网关、另一个协议面（/v1/messages），排在上面那条之后：openai 面在网关池里一个能接的成员都没有时（池级熔断 503，正文带 reason=face_has_no_serving_member），路由换到这一条继续走，而不是把 503 交给调用方。每次请求仍从索引 0 起试，所以那一面一旦重新有成员就自然切回，不需要谁改配置。两个面都是网关的，所以这里同样零厂商名、零凭证；model 仍是占位。

nats._comment_consumer: 消费者侧的界与自动建流的保留策略。ack 等待要盖过最坏单条处理时延（记忆摄取含归档与两次 LLM 调用，分钟级），否则处理途中重投会重复消费；max_deliver 是毒药消息的判定，超次写 DLQ 后 ack 终止；max_ack_pending 是背压闸门，积压留在流里而不是消费进程内存里。stream_retention 默认 workqueue（任一消费组 ack 后即删，任务分发语义）；事件面等多订阅方场景必须是 limits，否则先 ack 的组会把消息从别的组嘴里删掉——注意既有流上不能把 retention 改入/改出 workqueue，改它只能删流重建。

dag_executor._comment_task_lease_secs: 任务租约时长（秒）：执行者拿到任务时写下「我持有它到此刻」，之后按这一时长的三分之一心跳续期。持有者的进程被换掉后心跳就停，租约到期即判为可回收，任务回到重试而不是卡在 Running 到不了任何终态。取值要大于 system.timeout_checker_interval_secs，否则一次扫描还没到就已被判过期；也不宜太短，比单次任务正常时长还短会误伤正在跑的活。

metrics._comment_sample_max_rows: cog_metrics_samples 是只追加的观测样本日志，这条是它的容量上限（行数），0=不清理。清理的判据是容量不是时间：时间窗两个问题都答不了——流量可以在任何窗内塞进任意多行，而清理仍然会删掉正在读的行、留着没人要的行。清理按最早的先删，直到回到上限为止，但每个 gauge series 的最新一行永不删——gauge 的值就是这张表里它最新那条，删掉等于这个 series 从 /metrics 上消失，读起来是「从来没存在过」而不是「被裁掉了」；计数器与直方图不受这条地板保护，它们的值存在各自的累计表里，日志里的行只是喂给它的历史，整段可删——否则按对象取键的计数器（序列只增不复用）会让地板无限长大，容量旋钮永远咬不住，每轮都自报超容量却一行都删不掉。若光是这些最新行就超过上限，清理停在最新行上并通过 metrics_samples_over_capacity=1 说出来。默认值按开发集群实测的观测速率（约每天 2.2 万行）取约十天，比稳态高一个数量级，正常运转够不着，而失控的探测循环会在几小时内撞上而不是先把卷写满。属主由租约选举，不由部署标志钉死：清理是这张表上的单写者动作，属主写在共用库的一行租约里，两个副本同时开着也只有一个真删——没拿到租约的那个只量大小、照常上报，不参与清理，也不对外产生副作用；属主被杀后，另一个在租约到期后的下一轮接管。这个数于是从「谁是属主」退回成「哪些副本有资格当属主」（租约只在开着清理的进程之间争）：进化 Pod 的部署环境里置 COGNEVA_METRICS_SAMPLE_MAX_ROWS=0，是不让自进化 Pod 去持这张表的角色。已退场的名字（没有任何产者再写它）不看容量，也不靠这条清理放行，而是由独立的释放 pass 挂在这个循环上每轮清一遍四处存储（样本日志加三张累计表），删掉多少行按表分组报在 metrics_retired_rows_removed 上。
metrics._comment_scrape_dimensions: 抓取的可选收窄项，空数组=不收窄。不收窄的含义是：向每个 observable 询取它自己声明的、序列基数有界的全部维度。有界性由产者声明，不由这份清单判定——同一维度名在不同 observable 上可以不同（D1 在 orchestrator 是进程级累计计数器，有界；在 agent 是逐 step 按 task_id 取键的记录，无界），所以写死一份全局清单必然对其中一家是错的：旧清单把 D1 整条排除，orchestrator 那份有界的 D1 就永远读不到；而清单里列了 D4/D5/D6/D8/D9 时，agent 的 collect_metrics 会在五次询问里各回一份它那组不随维度变的累计计数器，同一批样本在同一个抓取体里出现五遍。要收窄时在这里写具体的维度名，它只会比产者声明的更少，不会多——写了没人声明的名字或声明为无界的名字，结果是采不到而不是报错。

raw_logger._comment: 这里写的已是部署的生效值，不再由 cogneva-config 的同名 env 覆盖：同一个设置在两个地方各写一份，读配置文件的人就推不出 runtime 用的是哪份，而 base_dir 还兼着 trace 存储的根（<base_dir>/traces），改错了不报错，只把 trace 写到另一个目录去。env 映射仍留在本文件的 env 段，要按环境改动时走那里。
raw_logger._comment_format: proto：记录按长度分隔的 protobuf 落地（<stream>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.proto.bin），比 jsonl 省去字段名开销，也是分层迁移压缩的输入。读取侧同时认 jsonl 与 proto，所以存量 .jsonl 文件不用搬。
raw_logger._comment_flush_interval_secs: 落盘由两个条件触发：缓冲满 max_buffer_size 条，或距上次落盘满 flush_interval_secs 秒。低流量 stream 可以长时间够不到条数阈值，那期间写下的记录全在进程内存里，进程一挂即失——所以时间上界不能省。置 0 只留条数阈值。

memory._comment: Memory backend — composite puts Raw on the shared ObjectBackend, Schema and the Summary entry store on PostgreSQL, and the summary vectors on the shared VectorBackend, so the dataset survives a restart. This applies to the processes that enable it: the evolution worker overrides COGNEVA_MEMORY_ENABLED to false, so it holds no memory dataset at all and any state it must keep across a restart lives in its own app.data_dir instead.
memory._comment_models: load_*_model gates the ONNX weights loaded at startup. Both stay false in this document, and the deployments that have weights on disk turn them on from the outside (env overrides, so profiles that mount nothing are unaffected). What decides it is whether a weight directory exists: the weights are deliberately kept out of the image and out of the release archive (4.6GiB total, and gzip cannot shrink fp32 weights), so a pod can only read them from a directory somebody put on its node first. Turning a switch on without one sends the loader to the model hub at startup, and on an offline or restricted network that fetch neither succeeds nor fails, so plugin init hangs until the liveness probe kills the pod. Embedding opens two sessions over one set of BGE-M3 weights -- dense and sparse, the two halves of hybrid retrieval -- and a process holding both measures 1.67GiB peak RSS, the same as one session alone: both read those same weight files, so the second session costs almost nothing. The reranker is a different model and measures 1.67GiB on its own. The sparse session's failure does not take the dense one down.
memory._comment_auto_ingest: Off: the pipeline pays a model call for every agent session's transcript and writes the result into the `default` namespace, while every in-process reader queries `knowledge`, `task_decomposition`, `implementation` or `failure_pattern` -- four namespaces that held 11 rows in total when this was measured on 2026-11-05, against 124k extracted rows whose retrieval_count was 0 and last_retrieved_at NULL across the whole table. The cost was CNY 83 a day, the largest single line of LLM spend, and most of the transcripts it read were the platform's own decompose and replan chatter. Manual ingest and browsing what has already been extracted are unaffected; turn this back on when a reader queries `default` or the extractor writes where a reader looks.

ingest._comment: Auto-ingest pipeline knobs. Retries and the dead-letter queue apply to content-level failures (a message that cannot be extracted, however often it is retried); an unreachable upstream defers the message back to the event plane instead, so a capacity outage never decides which events enter memory.
ingest._comment_pull_gate: The pull gate has two inputs sharing one verdict: the security gateway's published pool snapshot (cross-process, known before an attempt is spent) and this process's own consecutive environment failures (a local fact that still holds when Redis has no key or the gateway restarted). Either one pauses pulling and the wait is the larger of the two. Pausing means not pulling, so messages keep their place in the event plane without spending a delivery attempt.
ingest._comment_reconcile: Startup reconcile only covers the window between a crash and the restart, so it also re-runs on an interval: an outage longer than the lookback would otherwise push early-archived, never-extracted raws out of the window for good. 0 keeps it startup-only. Inside the window every unextracted raw is re-driven each round; past it they are repaid at aged_out_redrive_batch per round, so an outage longer than the lookback leaves debt that is paid back rather than debt that is abandoned. When the debt is deeper than that batch, a quarter of it goes to the oldest entries: taking only from the newest end lets each round's arrivals push the boundary along, so the oldest debt would never come up and that part of the backlog reading would stop moving. A raw that failed on its own content is neither: it has a dead-letter record, and re-driving it would only reproduce that diagnosis.
ingest._comment_bus: Bus-mode consumer knobs (active when multi_backend_consumer.events_on_bus=true). bus_claim_min_idle_ms must exceed the worst-case single-event processing time so a live worker's job is never claimed away; JetStream redelivery is governed by ack_wait, the claim sweeper covers Redis-class backends.
ingest._comment_extraction_budget: The extractor sends one conversation per call, and its length used to be bounded upstream: the raw layer stored the projection the window had already trimmed, so a transcript could not outgrow one window and no bound was needed here. Raw now keeps the whole history of a run, so this is that bound made explicit -- same estimate as the context window (2 per CJK character, otherwise 4 per word), the two ends of the conversation are sent and the middle is elided with a marker naming how many turns and how much of it is missing. 0 sends the whole transcript, which is what a payload below one window costs today.
ingest._comment_benchmark: Evaluation-set isolation: a raw matched by either list is refused before it is archived or extracted, so it reaches no memory layer and is never sent to the extractor. Both lists are deployment and dataset facts and are empty by default, which means that rule is not in effect -- the raw tag rule is the one that is always live (a producer marks a raw with benchmark=true and it is refused regardless of these lists). benchmark_namespaces names the eval-dedicated bucket and covers a writer that puts its data there without a tag; benchmark_canary_markers carries the dataset's own marker strings and is the only rule that still recognises content that arrived through an ordinary task path into the default namespace with its tag lost. Refusals are counted on memory_operations_total, one cell per rule, so a deployment that has configured an empty surface can tell it apart from one that has refused nothing.

tier_migrator._comment: hot→warm 就地 zstd 压缩并删除源文件，warm→cold 上传对象存储再删本地，两步都不可逆——热层保留 hot_duration_secs，warm 保留 warm_duration_secs。
tier_migrator._comment_owner: 迁移必须只有一个属主：raw_log_index 按 (stream, log_date, format) 唯一，冷层对象键又不带进程身份，两个部署同时扫就会互相覆盖索引行与对象（谁后写谁赢，先写的那份不可找回且不报错）。属主由租约选举，不由部署标志钉死：参与迁移的副本各自周期性地问共用库上那行租约，只有拿到的那份真扫，属主被杀后另一个在租约到期后的下一次问询接管。所以 COGNEVA_TIER_MIGRATOR_ENABLED 是「这个 Pod 参不参与迁移」的选择，正确性不靠它。

agent_loop._comment_agent_id: 这里不写名字：池子里的每一位员工在被造出来时由管理器起名（登记即发工号），这一段只是给它们同一套参数。写一个名字进来，读配置的人会以为平台上真有那一位，而名册上没有它。
agent_loop._comment_max_iterations: 这里不写轮数，就是不给智能体设轮数天花板：一轮什么时候结束由模型自己不再要工具来定，与交互面板里那个员工跑的是同一条循环。要设就写 `max_iterations`（生产运行）与/或 `eval_max_iterations`（评测运行），那是一个具体的部署决定，不是平台的缺省。止损不靠轮数：单步停滞超时管「不吭声」，上下文窗口管「装不下」，成本记在使用账上，任务由心跳回收。
agent_loop._comment_web: 网页检索与抓取两个端点：`web_search` / `web_fetch` 只问这两处，评测台的 HLE 列也读同一对（`cogneva eval-table` 的工具面里那两件就是这两个工具）。写在文件里而不是只写在各部署的 env 上：挂这份文件的 Pod 不止主应用与进化 worker——评测台与 mcp 服务也挂，只写 env 的那两处会让它们读到「这个部署没接网页能力」，而能力其实在。地址由 chart 按 values 替换，见 templates/app-config.yaml 的替换表。

loki._comment: 应用侧结构化日志的耐久面。主应用与进化进程的 tracing 事件此前只有 stdout 一张脸，随 Pod 消失（raw stream 存的是 LLM/协议原始报文，不是运行日志）；默认端点指向集群内观测栈。网关那一侧另有自己的 pusher，读的是同一份配置段。
loki._comment_batching: 推送的批与退避：max_batch_size 条或 flush_interval_sec 秒先到者触发一次落盘；timeout_secs 是单次推送的等待上界，max_retries 是推送失败后的重试次数。这三条决定 Loki 短时不可达时进程内存里能压多少日志、以及一次故障要重投多久。

config_declaration._comment: 本进程读到的配置文档，与本 rev 声明的那份是否同一份。规则住在文档里，所以没有任何一条规则能报出文档自己没到；这一判在代码里跑，拿进程启动时读的那份，比对本二进制编译进来的那份。三次读取：settle_secs 之后的第二次是为了把「挂载还没跟上」和「文档确实落后」分开——文件在此期间已经前进，说明进程只是被替换的路上，不是卡住。第二次仍然落后时再等 hold_secs 读第三次：换版的 Pod 在这个窗口里被替换掉、判据随之消失，而卡在旧文档上的进程活得比自己的替换更久——2026-10-22 实测，一次改配置的滚动会为此先写一行 73 秒的告警，而那是「我的替换还没发生」，不是故障。

infra_watch._comment: 基础设施告警→持久化→自发现。规则即部署策略：阈值改这里不用重建镜像。series 消失或条件不再成立会自动 resolve；规则查询失败不会误 resolve。
infra_watch._comment_for_seconds: 每条规则可选 `for_seconds`：条件要一直成立这么久才落行。默认不写＝第一拍就落行。只有当「读数会随着产出者重启而消失」时才需要它——比如走卷的扫描器每 5 分钟重发一次、Prometheus 在最后一次抓取 5 分钟后丢掉目标序列，于是 DaemonSet 一滚，「这些 claim 没有读数」这种形状就自己出现了。窗口取「扫描间隔＋序列失效时间」再加余量。语义照抄 Prometheus 规则文件的 `for`：条件断掉或查询失败都让时钟从零再数；已经在响的行照旧每拍刷新，窗口只管新行。
infra_watch._comment_mirror_alerts: Prometheus 自己求值的告警里，哪些该抄进同一张告警表。这里给一对标签键值：带这对标签的 firing 告警每拍被抄成一行，Prometheus 里不再 firing 就 resolve。标在规则上而不是列在这里，是为了让规则和它的投递声明同一次改动落地、改名也丢不掉投递。名字已经在本进程 rules 里的跳过：那条由进程内求值记账，两个写者会为同一件事开两行。不配 = 不抄。另外两个键：`include_unmarked` 打开后连**不带标记**的告警也抄——集群自带的规则库（kube-prometheus 的 KubeJobFailed、CPUThrottlingHigh 一类）不带这个标记，不打开它们就永远进不了账本，账本也就不是全集；打开之前先确认读这张表的任务面排得空，因为每一行都会开一个演进任务。`exclude` 里点名的规则无论带不带标记都不抄，默认是 kube-prometheus 的两个哨兵：Watchdog 按构造常亮、InfoInhibitor 在没有任何 info 级告警时亮，两者进账本都只是在描述「没事」。
infra_watch._comment_retired_rules: 已经停用的规则名。从 rules 里删掉一条规则不会动它已经开着的行，那些行会以「正在持续」的样子一直留在 state=firing 那一面上（resolved_at 空、last_seen_at 停在删除那一刻），会去关它的只有那条规则自己，而它已经不在了。点名在这里的，watcher 启动时按普通解析的同一路径把它们结算掉。停用的名字不能同时出现在 rules 里。

rules.name: node_disk_usage_high
rules.summary: root filesystem usage on {node} above 75% (current {value}%) The publishing pod is a scrape detail, not the subject: it is deleted and recreated with every monitoring rollout, so it is aggregated out while the label naming the subject is left untouched.

rules.name: node_disk_usage_critical
rules.summary: root filesystem usage on {node} above 85% (current {value}%); kubelet eviction starts soon The publishing pod is a scrape detail, not the subject: it is deleted and recreated with every monitoring rollout, so it is aggregated out while the label naming the subject is left untouched.

rules.name: node_disk_pressure
rules.summary: kubelet reports DiskPressure; pods are being evicted The publishing pod is a scrape detail, not the subject: it is deleted and recreated with every monitoring rollout, so it is aggregated out while the label naming the subject is left untouched.

rules.name: node_memory_pressure
rules.summary: kubelet reports MemoryPressure The publishing pod is a scrape detail, not the subject: it is deleted and recreated with every monitoring rollout, so it is aggregated out while the label naming the subject is left untouched.

rules.name: pod_restarting_fast
rules.summary: A container restarted more than 5 times in 15m ({value}). Not scoped to one namespace: a crash loop is the same defect wherever it runs, and a namespace matcher is a hand-written list -- the observability backends sat outside the one we had and their loop reached no rule at all. The window is a range selector, and a range selector keeps matching the samples of a series whose pod has already been deleted: without the second conjunct this rule kept firing for up to fifteen minutes on a pod that a rollout had replaced, with the dead pod's name in its labels. The conjunct asks that the same series was scraped within the last five minutes, so the subject still exists; five minutes covers a scrape stall without hiding a live container

rules.name: pod_oom_killed
rules.summary: A container's last exit was OOMKilled ({value}); its footprint exceeded the limit it was given. Not scoped to one namespace, and a state rather than a rate: a container killed at its cap holds this state until a clean stop, and one that dies every couple of hours never trips a restart-rate rule. The clickhouse instance in monitoring was killed five times in one hour while this rule could not see it

rules.name: ralph_loop_terminations_high
rules.summary: Ralph loops stopped {value} times in the last 30m without passing their goal. This rule sums over every reason a loop can stop for -- any stop is worth seeing -- but the reasons are not interchangeable, so this text does not name one: the reason that moved it is {reason}, and the alert's identity carries it, so two different reasons are two different alerts. A loop killed from outside has not answered the budget question at all; only a reason that says the chain gave up on its own has.

rules.name: declared_failure_class_unrecorded

_comment_dormancy.why: cog-collaboration/src/observable.rs emits this gauge only on the branch where a failure class could not be recorded; healthy operation exports nothing, which the rule reads as "no problem".

rules.summary: A declared failure class is being announced while its series stays at zero, so the classification is being lost between the producer and the termination record; the class label names which one

rules.name: self_evolution_yields_no_change
rules.summary: Self-evolution chains reported success {value} time(s) in the last 6h while producing no change to land. The cell names which failure it was, and they have different owners: submit_failed means a diff was produced and every sink refused it; no_artifacts means the run's answer carried no artifact at all; non_change_artifacts means it carried artifacts and not one of them was a diff, so the run answered a different question than the one it was asked; payload_missing means the run handed back no result to read; payload_unreadable means the result arrived in neither envelope this build knows, so the reader and the producer have moved apart. Whichever cell it is, the landing channel stays empty and the loop silently stops evolving. The count is taken once for the fleet rather than summed over the processes that expose it: this counter is held in the shared store, so every pod of every deployment serves the same total, and summing them would report one run once per replica

rules.name: cogneva_workload_metrics_unscraped
rules.promql: count(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="cogneva", image=~".*cogneva.*"} and on(pod) kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="cogneva", phase="Running"} == 1 and on(pod) (time() - kube_pod_start_time{namespace="cogneva"} > 900) unless on(pod) kube_pod_owner{namespace="cogneva", owner_kind="Job"} unless on(pod) present_over_time(up{namespace="cogneva"}[15m]) unless on(pod) kube_pod_labels{namespace="cogneva", label_cogneva_io_readings_delivery="push"})
rules.summary: {value} running cogneva workload(s) has no Prometheus scrape target to read it: its /metrics is produced but never collected, so every alert it would raise is invisible (usual causes: the workload has no Service, its Service port is not named http or metrics, or a NetworkPolicy blocks the monitoring namespace). A healthy window answers with no series at all rather than with a zero, because the count is over an empty set: an empty graph here means nothing is missing, not that the query broke. Do not add `or vector(0)` -- that would read "the target list could not be read" as "nothing is missing", which is harder to notice than an empty graph. The left side is one population -- running non-Job pods carrying a cogneva image, at least fifteen minutes old -- and a pod is dropped from it only when no scrape target has existed for it at any sample in the last fifteen minutes, so the zero point is zero by construction. The two conditions that are not about the population itself are both there because a pod being replaced is briefly a running pod with no target: replayed over six hours, the plain form read one to three pods at four instants, and every one of them was either a pod whose target had just been removed by its own rollout or a pod that had only just started, whose target had not been discovered yet. Each lasted a single evaluation. Fifteen minutes of age and fifteen minutes without a target remove both, and what they remove is churn rather than the defect: a workload with no scrape face at all stays that way for as long as it runs. It reads one evaluation rather than an average because the thing it reads is a list of targets, which is a fact about now. It used to subtract an unfiltered count of targets in the namespace, which let a target that is not a cogneva workload (a redis exporter here) and a duplicated target stand in for a real gap: measured over the six hours to 2026-10-16T20:15Z, 360 of 361 one-minute samples of that difference were non-zero -- it sat at -1 (this namespace carries exactly one target that is not a cogneva workload) and swung between -2 and +3 on the minutes a pod was being replaced -- so one unscraped workload could be cancelled out and never reported. One workload is outside the population by its own declaration rather than by being impossible to read: cogneva-process-census carries cogneva.io/readings-delivery=push on its pod because it has no /metrics at all -- it posts its readings to the gateway -- and a rule that counts it every minute raises a warning nobody can act on. The exclusion reads that declaration through kube_pod_labels, which kube-state-metrics exports only for allowlisted keys; if that surface ever vanishes the unless matches nothing and the rule goes back to counting the census pod, so the failure direction is a noisy alert rather than a silent one. A workload that serves /metrics declares nothing and stays in the population.

trace_collector._comment: trace 事件按 agent 在内存缓冲直到 AgentEnd 落盘；长任务无界累积会 OOM。超过预算即分块落盘（part 后缀），预算按部署内存定。

data_volume_watch._comment: 应用数据目录的占用量由写它的进程自己量成 gauge cogneva_data_volume_used_bytes 并带上卷名，规则拿它除以 kube-state-metrics 报的 requests.storage。同一份 cogneva.json 挂给多个 Pod，各自挂的卷不是同一张，所以卷名由各部署用自己的 env 指名（COGNEVA_DATA_VOLUME_CLAIM），不写在这里；claim 为空即整个观测关闭。没有应用数据目录、只有挂载表的进程（独立子命令与边车）用 COGNEVA_DATA_VOLUME_MOUNTS 的 claim=路径 列表声明，卷名就在那一行里；这条序列只能由挂载着该卷的进程走查产出——问得出来的那份是另一个量（引用字节），不是盘上占用。

self_review._comment: PGE actor self-review quality gate. enabled=true 时 Planner/Generator/Evaluator/Moderator/Merger 的输出会经过 SelfReviewLoop 审查。
self_review._comment_revise: revise=true 是完整循环：判完再让模型把整篇改写一次，再判改写。false 是只判不写：一次调用，把要求逐条判成 met／unmet／undetermined，判 met 的那条必须引正文原话，由代码逐字核对，查不到的按没满足算；分数由代码按「满足条数÷判过条数」算出来，不是模型报的。判据按角色分：计划按计划判（「没有回答任务」不算它的缺陷），判词按判词判，答案按答案判。正文原样交回调用方，未满足的条目进判词，由它自己的重试路径重做。改写约占一次评审的 64%，且它评判的标准与生产者已经拿到的标准是同一份。不写这一键的旧配置仍是 true。
self_review._comment_quality_threshold: quality_threshold 只在 revise=true 的循环里起作用：那一路把模型自己报的分与它比。revise=false 的一次调用表判不看这个数——通过的条件是「没有一条 unmet，也没有一条自称 met 却引不出正文原话」，分数由代码按表算出来，是给人读的读数，不参与判定。

pge._comment: PGE actor 输出契约。schemas 按 actor 名（planner/generator/evaluator/moderator/merger）配置 JSON Schema；配置后 schema 会注入 prompt 上下文并对 LLM 原始输出做校验，校验失败仅告警并回退宽松解析，不会中断流水线。默认为空 = 使用内置契约。
pge._comment_local_repair_max: 局部修复预算：Evaluator 判失败后保持当前 Plan 不变、把 feedback 回传给 Generator 再生成的次数，耗尽才做全局重置（重跑 Planner）。0 = 关闭这条路径，于是每次失败都从新 Plan 重来。写在这里是因为 schemas 一旦配置就很难注意到这条键缺了，而缺了的读法是 0。

ralph._comment: Ralph Loop 的预算与停滞窗口。这两条界决定一条不收敛的链在什么位置停下：max_iterations 是单次执行的迭代硬上限，stagnation_window 是最近多少轮没有进展即终止。两条都按次计、不跨执行累计。

agent._comment: Agent 注册与心跳。registration_ttl_secs 是注册表里一条 agent 记录的存活秒数（cog-storage 写注册时取它），heartbeat_interval_secs 是 worker 向注册表续约的间隔（cog-agent 建 worker 时取它）。两处都在进程启动时读，改一个值要重启工作负载才生效。

prompts._comment: 外部 prompt 模板目录，由 cogneva-prompts configmap 挂载；hot_reload 捕捉 configmap 交换（L0 配置晋级热更新通道）。

agent_pool._comment_worker_count: 并发上限，操作者自己写下的数，0 = 不声明。实际并发由容器内存读数与单任务实测开销每三十秒算一次，比它更紧时以它为准；量不到单任务开销时（本平台的活跑在沙箱 Pod 里，这个进程的内存读数不随它变）这个数是唯一的界，不写就永远停在 1。

self_evolution._comment: Self-evolution auto-deploy pipeline. enabled/auto_apply/auto_deploy all true means fully autonomous: LLM generates code changes, tests, commits, builds, and switches binary without human intervention. Sandbox boundary check: real apply/deploy requires a detected isolated environment (K8s Pod/container/COGNEVA_SANDBOX), sandbox_mode=true, or force_autonomous=true; otherwise the pipeline downgrades to dry-run.
self_evolution._comment_test_command: 变更落地前判它的是这条命令，跑在应用后的工作树里。这里写的就是代码默认值：文档显式给出沙箱会跑什么，读的人不必翻代码；部署要换判据就改这一条。

deploy_admission._comment: 触及 deploy/** 的变更按可执行条件准入，不转人工：chart 必须能渲染且 deploy/rendered 与 chart 一致（render-deploy.sh --check），chart 与 deploy/k3s 静态清单逐字段 parity（check-deploy-parity.sh），且渲染产物描述出来的控制面必须仍然可达（check-control-plane-reachability.sh：它判哪几族、每族的判据，由脚本头部的清单说，这里不再抄一遍——抄的那一份会随族的增加过期，而过期的注释没有任何东西读得出来）。三门都在应用后的树上跑，任一退出非零即拒收并点名；第三条判不了的形状（没有产物、解析失败、缺 python3-yaml）退出码 2，不当 0 读。helm 由 Pod 内挂载的宿主二进制提供；宿主没有 helm 时这一族被点名缺条件而拒收，不退回「等人批」。服务端 dry-run 目前不声明：判定身份按 Role 只在本命名空间，dry-run 覆盖不了的集群级对象会一律报未授权，把整族误杀；扩权是属主的动作。

web_admission._comment: 触及 web/src/** 的变更按可执行条件准入，不转人工：判它的是前端构建——按 lockfile 装依赖、类型检查、打包（deploy/scripts/web-build.sh），跑在应用之后的树上，退出码非零即拒收并点名。与 CI 的 Web Build 作业是同一个脚本、同一棵树：两处各写一份 npm ci && npm run build，抄的那一份迟早与另一份漂开，而漂开的形态是「作业绿、沙盒拒收」或者反过来，两种都要花一整轮才看得出来。判它的容器里必须有 node/npm（运行时镜像从构建 WebUI 的那一段拷来的同一份），没有时这一族按最严的可执行档处理：整族拒收，不退回「等人批」。边界只到 web/src/：web/ 下的 package.json / package-lock.json / vite 配置不在这一族里——加一个依赖是供应链决定，不是一次改动评审担得起的。

build_gate._comment: 宿主级构建闸门：同一宿主同时进行的编译/打镜像条数上限；这个上限默认不是写死的数：0 表示按宿主实测导出（宿主的 cpu、内存、io 三项，加上构建所在容器的内存上限，四维各答「还装得下几条」，取最紧的一项说几就几；四维各自的答案同时发在 cogneva_build_gate_dimension_ceiling 上，最紧的那条再以 dimension 标签标在 cogneva_build_gate_ceiling 上），正数才是钉死它的覆盖位，此时读数 cogneva_build_gate_ceiling 的 dimension 标签写 override 而不是 cpu / memory / io / cgroup_memory。宿主面每一项读数都单独发布而不只发判决：忙核与总核（cogneva_host_cpu_busy_cores / _cpu_cores）、可用内存（cogneva_host_memory_available_bytes）、三条压力（cogneva_host_pressure_avg60{resource=cpu|io|memory}）、构建卷空闲字节（cogneva_host_disk_free_bytes，statvfs 现读，读不到就是没有这条序列而不是零），加四维各自的答案（cogneva_build_gate_dimension_ceiling{dimension}）。每一条都有人接手，判据分两档：界除的那几条（忙核、总核、可用内存、io 压力）由界自己消费，剩下的（cpu 压力、内存压力、构建卷空闲字节）各有一条已发货的规则在读，**按格算不按名字算**——同一个名字下的 cpu/io/memory 三格是三件读数，一条规则读了其中一格不能替另外两格作数（2026-10-21 前的闭集测试按名字匹配，cpu 与内存两格因此空转了两天）。闸门读不到宿主时一条都不发，`build_gate_host_readings_unpublished` 专门报这一态——规则在而读数空，与「宿主很闲」同形，所以配对报。构建与集群同宿主，多路叠加足以把整机拖进换页，此后连应该把这件事报出来的事件循环也一起退化。闸门只装在跑构建的进程里，锁定的是 lock_dir 这一个目录：两个进程指向同一个目录（同一 dev:ino）才互相设界，指向不同目录则各自设界——读数 cogneva_build_gate_slots 的 dir 标签就是用来分辨这件事的，role 标签分辨「跑构建的进程（builder）」与「不跑构建的进程（control-plane，只发零值）」。
build_gate._comment_measurements: 下面十个数是本部署宿主上的实测出厂值，不是定律：一个构建吃几个核、峰值多少内存、除构建外宿主必须留住多少、多安静算安静、界的移动阻尼与采样间隔。换一台机器就该在这里重量一遍、改掉。其中 build_demand_cores 与 build_peak_rss_mib 描述的是机器而不是构建，读它们的一层会压到本机付得起的范围（核数、MemTotal 减一个构建的峰值），只压不抬，读数 source 标签写 fitted。实测口径在 cog-core 的字段注释里。

artifact_evolution._comment: Autonomous search over the meta-learning policy's tuning parameters (min_samples, margin). Each round replays the recorded decision outcomes under every candidate parameter set and adopts one only when a two-proportion z-test says it beats what the recommendation path is currently using; the winner is saved as a new version and hot-swapped. The input is this process's own recorded results, so it runs without LLM or network access. min_trials is the floor — below it the test cannot be significant and the round writes nothing. Ownership: the policy artifact lives under this process's own data dir, so this loop needs no per-deployment owner switch.

multi_backend_consumer._comment: events_on_bus=true: AgentEnd is published only to the persistent event plane (dedicated NATS JetStream at nats_urls, decoupled from the task-queue backend); the supervisor re-injects it into the broadcast exactly once and memory-ingestor consumes from the bus with ack-after-processing. Publish-side knobs bound the in-memory buffer that covers NATS outage windows.

github_integration._comment: GitHub integration for self-evolution. Tokens are resolved from environment variables and never enter the sandbox. discovery_mode=both: polling is the periodic fallback, webhook events (via the security gateway, gateway_verified) give second-level response.
github_integration._comment_discovery_enabled: Whether THIS process takes part in discovery at all. One binary serves several deployments (main app, evolution pod, security gateway, sandbox executor) and each of the first two builds its own plugin table, so a process that takes part contends for the discovery role over the shared database: each participating replica asks the lease on its own cadence, only the holder scans and follows up, and the role moves to another replica on the next ask after a holder that was killed stops renewing its term. Without that arbitration two processes scan the same upstream items and ask the same clarification twice: intent guards are per-pod files, so neither can see the other already acted. The webhook event entry is deliberately not part of the lease — which process receives issue/comment events is a routing decision made where the events are delivered, and the periodic poll is the fallback for what the events do not reach. Deployment sets this false on the evolution pod, which therefore neither polls nor receives events.

webhook._comment: Webhook event entry, used when discovery_mode=events/both. gateway_verified=true: platform signatures are verified at the security gateway (8082); this process only verifies the gateway's internal HMAC (COGNEVA_WEBHOOK_INTERNAL_SECRET) and serves GitHub + Gitee events on the same port. Gitee events arrive at the fixed path /webhooks/gitee.

github_integration._comment_git_workdir: Local git working copy the landing channel commits and pushes from. Empty derives one under the data dir (COGNEVA_DATA_DIR/git-workdir); whether changes actually go upstream is the contribution policy's decision, not a path setting. Git transport goes through the security gateway HTTPS proxy (COGNEVA_GIT_PROXY_BASE, set in deployment env); no token or deploy key lives in this pod.
github_integration._comment_api_base: GitHub API base override. Point it at the security gateway passthrough endpoint (COGNEVA_GITHUB_API_BASE, e.g. http://cogneva-security-gateway:8081/github) so this process holds no platform token; leave null to talk to api.github.com directly with the token_env/inline token.

landing_policy._comment: Bounds what a landed change may touch, and what happens when CI on a landed commit fails. Quality is settled by the sandbox (pre-check, apply, test, release build) before the channel is called, so there is no score gate here; whether changes go upstream at all is the contribution policy's decision (auto/ask/local), so there is no on/off switch either.
landing_policy._comment_max_changed_lines: null = no ceiling. A ceiling here is what made a batched demand unlandable and therefore split into one task per item, and the split is what costs: every attempt pays a plan, a generation and a validation run whatever its size. Set a number only if you want a bound on one change's blast radius more than you want the merged form.
landing_policy._comment_forbidden_paths: deploy/ is deliberately absent: deploy changes are judged by the deploy admission gate (render freshness, parity, rollback, dry-run on the applied tree), so forbidding the path here would refuse them before that gate could run. The entries that stay have no executable judge.

gitee_integration._comment: Gitee integration, equal in status to GitHub: issues are external-intent evolution entries. Platform fields only; triage/conversation/auto-merge policies are inherited from github_integration. api_base defaults to the security gateway passthrough (COGNEVA_GITEE_API_BASE env); token lives only in the gateway.
